A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''member''' of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the individual was stationed on [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin base]] and questioned the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[X-7]], who was using the alias of [[X-7|S'ree Bonard]], when he landed on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Target" />

Due to the outdated Alliance landing codes that Bonard used, which were taken from the Rebel [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Jez Planchet]] under [[Torture/Legends|torture]], the individual was suspicious of him. Bonard explained to the individual that Planchet recruited him to the Alliance and asked him to report to the base. The individual tested Bonard by remarking that he must have met Planchet on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and Bonard correctly answered that he met Planchet instead on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], where the lieutenant was on a deep undercover mission.<ref name="Target" />
